title: lavandula sampaioana
intro: Lavandula sampaioana, commonly known as Portuguese lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Lavandula sampaioana include its sedative, calming, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and are responsible for its distinct aroma and flavor.
